checks.phone_enrollment: Real Android Keystore signature accepted over pinned TLS; matching codes compared before host approval; service profile updated only after approval.
checks.qr_camera: User reported scanning host invitation and seeing confirmation screen. Automated enrollment used the identical invitation through Pair link; this is not claimed as an automated camera enrollment test.
checks.phone_to_mac_handoff: Decoded QR displayed by phone; accepted ticket against real keeper; same PID and shell variable preserved; prior generation rejected; replay rejected.
checks.mac_to_phone_handoff: Phone accepted capsule for paired host/session; same PID; previous controller fenced and ticket consumed.
checks.desktop: Native macOS app rendered and typed into the existing phone shell; preserved variable visible. Local browser displayed same keeper PID.
checks.iterm: Existing inventory visible. A disposable new iTerm session received input through DOT and returned the expected marker via an independent iTerm API read. Existing sessions were not typed into.
checks.vault: Synthetic value absent from encrypted file bytes, file mode 0600, child process verified injected value; live audit showed prior disclosure with executable hash and later session ID. Wrong key/tampering regression tests pass.
checks.resources: Live machine and grouped-process measurements visible in native panel; read-only.
limits: Not an independently audited security product
No Internet relay or NAT traversal
No full styled screen reconstruction after history/size changes
iTerm bridge is text-only and does not acquire an exclusive iTerm lock
No vault export/recovery or credential-operation broker
No global firewall or resource enforcement
No Windows runtime or Android local shell
